federations.authority_boundary: Ruat Caelum receives deterministic routing authority only. Aspen Grove Core remains the canonical root, AKOS remains the governance authority, and original evidence remains authoritative in its owning source stores. This federation does not let Ruat, Aspen Grove, or storage location promote allegations, inferences, legal characterizations, OCR, transcripts or summaries into original evidence or verified fact.
